Dropped modifier/add-on rows (dressings, extra cheese, double meat charges) as not standalone dishes.

name: Dons Cocktail Lounge
notes: Worklist website (dons-cocktail-lounge.poi.place) is a barred directory-farm domain. Confirmed via Yelp/TripAdvisor/sagemenu that this is a dive bar / sports bar in El Cajon (13321 Hwy 8 Business, El Cajon, CA 92021 - matches worklist address) with live music, karaoke and pool tables. No food menu of any kind found on any source checked (sagemenu.com listing has only a photo gallery and reviews, no menu section; menupix.com 403'd). A couple of reviews mention food existing informally ('tasty spaghetti', one negative review mentioning 'expired food') but no restaurant-published, itemized, priced food menu exists anywhere - this is a drinks/cocktail-focused dive bar with no per-item food prices published.

name: The Food Box
notes: Restaurant's own Toast storefront, linked directly from tfbburgers.com (address confirmed: Garnet Avenue, Pacific Beach, San Diego 92109). The restaurant's own site embeds a Google Drive PDF menu image (menu iframe), but that PDF's 5 pages have no extractable text layer (pdftotext -layout and -raw both return nothing) and probe/extract_pdf_images.js pulled only small decorative food photos, not full-page renders - unreadable, so used Toast instead. Toast serves TWO parallel menus with identical category structure and item names but different prices: 'Full Menu' (dine-in) and 'Delivery Menu' - confirmed by the menu-nav tab labels in the HTML. Kept only the 'Full Menu' (dine-in) prices; the Delivery Menu duplicate was dropped entirely (e.g. Calvin Burger $11.99 dine-in vs $16.99 delivery, French Fries $4.99 vs $5.99). Markup test on the kept 35 Full Menu prices: 34/35 already land on round/.99/.50 endings at face value, and dividing by 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25 does not improve that - no additional fee detected. Categories covered: Starters, Burgers, Chicken, Beverages, Shakes, Kids, Sauce. A 'Desserts' category exists in the nav but rendered zero items in both menus - established as empty via the item count, not unread.
